questions.question: What is the primary benefit of Deferred Evaluation of Annotations (PEP 649)?
choices: Faster startup times and cleaner circular reference handling
Automatic conversion of Python code to C++
Disabling all runtime type checking completely
Replacing standard dict with compiled hash tables
questions.explanation: PEP 649 defers evaluation of type annotations until accessed, minimizing import overhead and avoiding circular import errors.

questions.question: Which aspect of the free-threaded (No-GIL) ecosystem received major improvements in Python 3.14?
choices: Broader C-extension compatibility and improved memory management
questions.explanation: Python 3.14 matures the free-threaded build by expanding C-extension support and optimizing memory management for parallel tasks.

questions.question: How did error reporting improve in Python 3.14?
choices: Errors are automatically sent to cloud logging services
Exceptions no longer halt program execution
Tracebacks pinpoint the exact expression causing the issue
All error messages are translated into binary bytecode
questions.explanation: Enhanced error messages and tracebacks now pinpoint the specific expression that caused the exception.
